method.build: Production Vite build in dist, exercised through vite preview at http://127.0.0.1:4195/?lang=en&seed=27; immutable Arcade package independently rebuilt in dist-arcade and checked against dist-arcade/release.json.

reached: English branching docket at hearing 1/8 with both encounter portraits visible
Whisper Jury active hearing, turn 1 and turn 2
Card-to-counsel target: Brace changed Block 0 to 5 and Focus 3 to 2
Card-to-opponent target: File Record changed claim 24 to 21, Evidence 0 to 1, and Focus 2 to 1
End Argument changed turn 1 to turn 2, restored Focus to 3, and drew five cards
Turn-2 Press changed claim 21 to 15 and Focus 3 to 2
unseen: The manual pointer session did not reach reward, recess, hearings 2-8, the High Judge, or a result screen.
The manual pointer session did not exercise Korean, pause, mute, resume, restart, or every enemy rule.
manualSession.coverageForUnseen: Those paths were checked by direct source/design comparison, the 29 creator tests including a complete nine-hearing winning rules path, the viewport game-over probes in both locales, and the production smoke/runtime checks. They are not claimed as manually observed.

designConformance.designClaim: Each hearing teaches and repeats a five-card draw, three Focus spend, targeted response, and visible enemy-turn resolution loop.
designConformance.observed: At 390x844, pointer input entered hearing 1 with five cards, Focus 3/3, Trust 48/48, and Attack 5 shown before action. Playing Brace and File Record spent Focus and changed Block, Evidence, and enemy claim; End Argument advanced to turn 2, reset Focus to 3, and drew five cards.

designConformance.designClaim: Inquiry, Evidence, Objection, and Appeal have distinct numerical roles, while post-hearing drafts and recess healing/upgrades materially grow the deck.
designConformance.observed: The production logic defines 12 playable cards plus Doubt with family-specific damage, draw, Evidence, block, weakening, and healing effects and upgraded values. Tests passed for three distinct draft choices, deck growth, upgrade preservation, card family/target validity, and a planned recovery/Evidence build through the final verdict; reward and recess UI handlers add a selected card, restore Trust 12, or upgrade the first eligible card.

designConformance.designClaim: Enemy-specific rules alter card selection: Jury adds Doubt, Witness punishes repeated families, Clerk seals Evidence and alternates Ward, Prosecutor halves healing, and later enemies add piercing, regeneration, and attack-pattern pressure.
designConformance.observed: Encounter cards expose the special rule before selection and the active hearing repeats it below the raster portrait. Passing tests exercised Clerk Evidence cost and Ward intent, Prosecutor healing reduction, Witness repeated-family damage, and Jury's initial loop; source comparison confirmed Jury curse cadence, Bailiff piercing, Archivist Ward regeneration, and Choir attack cadence.

designConformance.designClaim: Before acting, the player sees next intent and expected amount, Trust, Block, enemy claim and Ward, card costs, selected targets, Focus affordability, and status effects, with distinct visual/audio feedback.
designConformance.observed: The 390x844 hearing visibly showed Attack 5, Trust, Block, Evidence, Focus, enemy claim, card costs/effects, turn, draw/discard, and target instructions. Pointer plays immediately updated the displayed numbers. Passing tests covered Objection preview 6 to 3 and Ward +6 remaining unreduced; runtime code marks unaffordable cards NEED FOCUS and routes damage, defense, healing, card, win, and loss to distinct synthesized cues.

designConformance.designClaim: A three-act run contains eight branching normal/special hearings, a draft after every win, recesses after hearings 3 and 6, and a multi-stage High Judge whose admitted family rotates each round.
designConformance.observed: The first docket visibly offered two differently ruled opponents and the progress rail showed hearing 1/8. Source comparison found eight encounter pairs, reward routing after every non-boss win, recess routing at clears 3 and 6, final-hearing routing after clear 8, High Judge HP 60, rotating Evidence to Inquiry to Defense admissibility, off-family effect reduction, and a below-half attack increase. The complete nine-hearing winning rules test passed.

designConformance.designClaim: Trust reaching zero loses the case; defeating the High Judge wins it, and the result reports score, completed hearings, primary card family, and offers a new run.
designConformance.observed: Rules close a hearing loss at Trust 0 and close final victory when the Judge reaches 0 claim. Result rendering reports verdict, computed score, hearings out of 9, primary argument family, and New Case; 360x800 standalone and portal game-over probes reached valid Korean and English result UI with no offscreen elements or errors.

designConformance.designClaim: Normal gameplay uses an identity-defining non-SVG raster gouache-and-charcoal opponent medium, visibly present in both branching docket choices and active hearings.
designConformance.observed: The 390x844 production build visibly rendered distinct rough-paper, charcoal-outlined painted opponents in both branching encounter cards and the active Whisper Jury hearing. The medium is public/art/opponent-atlas.png, an RGB PNG at 1536x768, 2,191,914 bytes, SHA-256 34c5a39c5dc4f1c338384bae763a1d488bb2c05d3d741db2e7bb2ceb83a584f8. Runtime loads it with Pixi Assets, crops its 4x2 cells by enemy ID, and places 94x168 docket portraits plus a 138x116 active-hearing portrait. ART.md and provenance match the actual source PNG (1774x887, 3,101,069 bytes, SHA-256 867f3095c59705d61ce7a59974d54b3af532d12b8659ea0ada700ab0f402e81f) and packaged derivative.

designConformance.designClaim: The production game supports equivalent Korean and English information, pointer and keyboard play, pause/resume, mute, restart, and no audio before the first user input.
designConformance.observed: Locale parity tests passed for both production locales; viewport game-over probes passed in Korean and English. Pointer handlers unlock audio on user interaction, and runtime methods expose pause, resume, mute, locale, and restart behavior. The manual session independently exercised pointer targeting and turn completion.

creatorTests.covers: Five-card/three-Focus loop, damage and hand cycling, Clerk/Prosecutor/Witness rules, intent preview, Judge rotation and off-family reduction, drafts/upgrades, card families/targets, complete nine-hearing win path, raster asset integrity and both runtime placements, locale parity, records, and seeded RNG.

verificationCommands.result: TypeScript and Vite production build completed. Non-fatal warnings reported a 543.60 kB main chunk and the existing Capacitor mixed-import condition.
Built and verified 19 immutable files, 5,414,862 bytes, 311,485 JS gzip bytes; releaseSha 446d09900f3565f22088cdd36c4e6677321d7cdb.
Deployment-only mount succeeded at sourceHash e6d04e3d9b84d637ffe957c8cd74bef971ddc0211c4f5cadbb50cade96ba9edb with zero console and page errors.
360x800, 390x844, 430x932, and 900x760-wide passed in standalone and portal shapes; Korean and English game-over probes passed.
Portal stylesheet and 390x844 canvas loaded; CSP violations, runtime errors, and missing assets were all zero.

deployable.observed: The current sourceHash equals smoke-result.json and verification/viewport-result.json. Production and Arcade builds, immutable release verification, deployment smoke, all requested viewport shapes, and portal CSP passed. dist-arcade/release.json includes art/opponent-atlas.png at 2,191,914 bytes with SHA-256 34c5a39c5dc4f1c338384bae763a1d488bb2c05d3d741db2e7bb2ceb83a584f8; the preview fetched /art/opponent-atlas.png as HTTP 200 image/png with the same length and hash, and the manual production session rendered it without console-visible failure.

notes: Manual reach is intentionally reported only through hearing 1 turn 2; no claim is made that later run screens were manually played.
The Vite chunk-size and Capacitor import warnings do not prevent the build, exceed no stated release budget, and did not produce runtime errors in the verification runs.
No design, implementation, GDD, ART, or narrative file was changed by this review.

summary.ko: 여섯 덱빌딩 완성 약속과 비SVG 래스터 플레이 매체가 최종 설계와 프로덕션 빌드에 구현됐다. 390×844 실제 포인터 플레이, 29개 제작자 테스트, 웹·아케이드 빌드, 릴리스 검증, 스모크, 뷰포트와 CSP가 모두 통과해 출고 가능하다.
summary.en: All six deckbuilding completeness promises and the non-SVG raster gameplay medium are implemented in the final design and production build. Actual 390x844 pointer play, 29 creator tests, web and Arcade builds, release verification, smoke, viewport, and CSP checks all passed, so the release is deployable.
